experimental_2021.authors: Cossard, Gerchen, Li, Cuenot & Pannell (Current Biology, 2021)
experimental_2021.ploidy: diploid, male XX-only descendants versus original XY male donors
experimental_2021.common_garden: G0 through G4 source seeds raised simultaneously in randomized blocks under identical pollen environment, allowing separation of current plastic treatment from inherited or maternal lineage effects; genetics vs epigenetics not identified

selfing_genotypes.source_method: RMES on progeny SSR; not direct per-offspring selfed assignment

G5_reintroduced_males.method: Indirect inference from proportion of Y-bearing sons; assumes XY fathers produce equal sexes, XX female pollen only X daughters; NOT SSR assignment of fathers or direct selfing vs XX-outcross separation

experimental_2021.source_conflict: Original Results mentions 20 source populations while original STAR Methods specify 35 source demes; unresolved, use source block with caution
experimental_2021.original_Data_S1: Publisher lists Excel raw fields for field population, common garden, mating arrays, but workbook not obtained or refit in this task

architecture_2019.authors: Santos Del Blanco, Tudor & Pannell (Ecology Letters, 2019)
architecture_2019.morphs: Female-like monoecious axillary short inflorescences vs male-like monoecious pedunculate long inflorescences vs males in different natural population source material

exp1.source: Arrays with XY males present; authors infer paternal contribution from male progeny

exp2.source: F-like vs M-like competition; maternal/selfing assignments by SSR source category
exp2.assumption: ~31% difference calculated under assumed equal selfing in both morphs because M-like selfing unidentifiable

critical_scope: G0 2.33× acute response and 2021 G4 23.3× evolution derive from same experiment, not two independent origins
G4 23.3× is relative to contemporaneous control females, not 23.3× G0 itself
Published G1/G4 RMES selfing means .19/.12 decrease was not statistically significant (p=.10); cannot infer more male flowers means monotonically more selfing
G5 12.8% female siring uses 2×(0.5−0.436), not 2×(0.503−0.436), and source is inferred from sex ratio not directly father-genotyped
2019 25–31% female-like inflorescence siring disadvantage is independent source material from 2021 evolved XX females; not a direct same-genotype counterfactual
2019 observed source morphology differs with population and genes; source study does not isolate peduncle architecture in same isogenic background
2021 source G0 provenance inconsistency 20 populations vs 35 demes remains unresolved
Follow-up 2025 New Phytologist and 2026 PNAS reuse evolved XX lineages (not independent reversals)
No actual multigeneration return-to-dioecy after XY male reintroduction was observed; single G5 mating array tests ability to sire under male competition
No novel field data, raw Data S1 files, complete SLK Phi/g0/Delta_R or whole-lifetime rare mutant invasion rates
